gates.description: Gate A1 is located at the far north end of Terminal 1, near the international departures wing. It serves wide-body aircraft including Boeing 777 and Airbus A380 flights.

navigation.landmark_description: Near the large Mumbai mosaic mural, north end of T1 Level 2

route: Proceed to International Check-in Zone A

gates.description: Gate A2 is adjacent to Gate A1 in Terminal 1, positioned right after the first set of escalators. It handles mid-range international routes.

navigation.landmark_description: First set of escalators, A-wing, Level 2, Terminal 1

gates.description: Gate B12 is located in Terminal 2, on Level 2, accessible via the central elevator bank or escalators from the B-concourse entrance. Follow the blue 'B Gates' signs from the security checkpoint. It primarily serves domestic and regional flights.

navigation.landmark_description: Level 2 B-wing, follow blue 'B Gates' signs from T2 security

accessible_route: Use C-wing elevator (B-wing elevator under maintenance)

known_delays.impact: Use C-wing elevator or stairs instead

gates.description: Gate C5 is in the south wing of Terminal 3, accessible via the moving walkway from the main Terminal 3 security exit. It serves low-cost carrier domestic flights.

navigation.landmark_description: South wing of Terminal 3, via moving walkway from main T3 security

accessible_route: Take accessible corridor south (parallel to moving walkway)

gates.description: Gate D3 is at the end of the D-concourse in Terminal 3. It is the furthest gate from security — take the shuttle train from the main terminal or walk 15 minutes. Serves charter and cargo-mixed flights.

navigation.landmark_description: End of D-concourse, Terminal 3. Take shuttle train from T3 main terminal.

route: Walk to shuttle train platform (4 min)
Board shuttle train to D-concourse (4 min)
accessible_route: Accessible path to shuttle train platform

terminals.name: Terminal 1
terminals.description: Terminal 1 is the international departures terminal, handling all intercontinental and long-haul international flights. It features a world-class duty-free mall, premium lounges, and fine dining. The terminal spans four levels connected by escalators, elevators, and moving walkways.

levels.L2: International Departures Check-in, Security, Gates A1-A20
levels.L3: Post-Security Retail, Food Courts, SkyLounge, Business Centre

terminals.access: Enter via the International Departures main entrance on Level 2. Dedicated drop-off zone on ground floor. Sky Bridge connects to the hotel on Level 3.

route: Exit Mumbai Metro Line 1 Sahar Station

from_t2_to_t1.notes: No direct shuttle between T1 and T2. Use taxi or airport transfer service.

terminals.name: Terminal 2
terminals.description: Terminal 2 handles domestic and short-haul international flights. It is modern and compact, designed for fast boarding. It features a food court, shopping, and quick-service lounges. Security is typically faster here than Terminal 1.
terminals.access: Enter via Terminal 2 Departure Hall on Level 2. Shared parking structure with Terminal 1. Shuttle bus connects Terminal 2 to Terminal 3 every 10 minutes.

route: Exit Mumbai Metro Line 1 Sahar Station

from_t2_to_t3.pickup_point: T2 main entrance ground level, Bay 3

terminals.name: Terminal 3
terminals.description: Terminal 3 is a dedicated low-cost carrier and regional terminal. It offers basic amenities with budget-friendly food and retail options. The terminal has two concourses, C and D, with D-concourse served by an automated shuttle train.

levels.L1: Departures Check-in, Security, Gates C1-C10, D-concourse via shuttle

terminals.access: Accessible via the Airport Ring Road on Level 1. Terminal 3 has its own dedicated check-in counters (rows C40-C60). Shuttle bus from Terminal 2 stops at the T3 main entrance.

from_t3_to_t2.dropoff_point: T2 main entrance ground level, Bay 3

food_outlets.name: Café Aroma
food_outlets.description: Café Aroma serves artisan coffees, fresh-baked pastries, sandwiches, and light bites. Perfect for a quick snack before a long international flight. Offers specialty blends from three continents.

current_offers.title: Buy any hot beverage, get a pastry at 50% off

best_for_age_groups.elderly: Comfortable seating, quiet ambience, easy menu
best_for_age_groups.adult: Great espresso and quick meal before boarding

time_sensitive_recommendation.under_20_min: Grab a packaged pastry and go

route: Café Aroma is right next to Gate A1

food_outlets.name: The Runway Grill
food_outlets.landmark: Window seating with airside views near Gate B12
food_outlets.description: The Runway Grill is the main sit-down restaurant in Terminal 2. It offers a full menu spanning Indian curries and thalis, continental mains, pasta, and a dedicated Chinese corner. Great choice for families.

current_offers.title: Family Combo - 2 Thalis + 2 Kids Meals at ₹999

best_for_age_groups.elderly: Comfortable seating, soft food options, thali meals easy to order
best_for_age_groups.adult: Full menu with Indian and continental options
best_for_age_groups.child: Dedicated kids menu, play-friendly environment near kids zone

time_sensitive_recommendation.under_20_min: Skip — take something from IndiaMart instead

food_outlets.name: Spice Garden
food_outlets.landmark: Level 3 food court, central zone T1
food_outlets.description: Spice Garden specialises in authentic South Indian breakfast items (idli, dosa, vada) as well as North Indian tandoori dishes and biryanis for lunch and dinner.

best_for_age_groups.elderly: Soft idli and dosa easy to eat, familiar Indian flavours
best_for_age_groups.adult: Hearty biryani or tandoor meals before long flights
best_for_age_groups.child: Plain dosa and lassi popular with kids

route: Food court signs to Spice Garden

food_outlets.name: QuickBite Fast Food
food_outlets.description: QuickBite is a 24-hour fast food outlet offering burgers, wraps, fries, cold beverages, and meal combos. Ideal for budget travellers seeking a fast and filling option.

best_for_age_groups.elderly: Simple menu, quick service, sitting area available
best_for_age_groups.adult: Fast and affordable meal before boarding

time_sensitive_recommendation.under_20_min: Self-order kiosk — fastest option in T3
time_sensitive_recommendation.over_45_min: Consider Grab & Go at D3 if heading to D-concourse

route: QuickBite at concourse entrance on right

food_outlets.name: Grab & Go Kiosk
food_outlets.landmark: Near shuttle train exit at D-concourse, beside Gate D3
food_outlets.description: Grab & Go Kiosk near Gate D3 offering quick packaged snacks, beverages, and light bites. Best for last-minute purchases before boarding.

time_sensitive_recommendation.under_20_min: Only option near D3 — grab something quickly
time_sensitive_recommendation.over_45_min: Go back to QuickBite in C-concourse for fuller meal

route: Grab & Go is right beside Gate D3
Grab & Go on right before Gate D3

shops.name: SkyMall Duty-Free
shops.landmark: Largest retail space in T1, immediately after security Zone A
shops.description: SkyMall is the flagship duty-free store in Terminal 1. It is the largest retail space in the airport, spanning 4,000 sq ft, stocking global luxury and lifestyle brands. Open to all international departing passengers.

current_offers.title: Buy 2 get 1 free on selected perfumes (Chanel, Dior)
15% off on all single malt Scotch whiskies above ₹5000
Complimentary luxury gift wrapping on purchases above ₹3000

time_sensitive_recommendation.under_20_min: Grab chocolates or a pre-packaged gift set — quick checkout
time_sensitive_recommendation.under_45_min: Browse perfumes or pick a bottle of whisky
time_sensitive_recommendation.over_45_min: Full shopping — electronics, perfumes, liquor, gifts

shops.landmark: Specialist liquor boutique beside Gate A2, T1
shops.description: World Spirits & Wines is a specialist liquor boutique offering curated collections of premium spirits from Scotland, France, Ireland, and more. Expert staff offer tasting recommendations.

current_offers.title: Buy any 2 bottles and get a premium whisky glass set free
10% extra discount when you spend over ₹8000
Special pricing on Moët & Chandon Champagne this week

time_sensitive_recommendation.under_20_min: Skip — browsing takes time, go to gate

shops.description: IndiaMart is the go-to convenience store in Terminal 2, stocking everything a traveller might need at the last minute — from medicines and snacks to phone chargers and neck pillows.
